_comment: Recurring jobs installed as launchd agents by scripts/scheduler/scheduled_jobs.py. Edit here, then run `jobs-install`. Each `command` runs under `/bin/zsh -lc`, so .zprofile (brew + asdf python) is loaded but interactive aliases are NOT -- spell the alias out. `schedule` takes launchd StartCalendarInterval keys (Minute, Hour, Day, Weekday 0=Sun, Month); a list means 'any of these'. A slot missed while the Mac sleeps fires once on wake.

jobs.name: claude-export
jobs.description: Daily export of Claude Code sessions into knowledge-base-private (same as the `claude-export` alias)
